vinayChittora.name: Vinay Chittora
vinayChittora.bio: Founder and editor of MHTR.in. Builds the site, the GIS maps and boundary files, the document archive and most of the field reports and photographs.

sonuKumar.name: Sonu Kumar
sonuKumar.bio: Naturalist and student of ecology working on plant diversity, bird observations, and biodiversity documentation in and around the Mukundara landscape.
